title: Cultural Value Alignment in Large Language Models: A Prompt-based Analysis of Schwartz Values in Gemini, ChatGPT, and DeepSeek
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark, Portrait Values Questionnaire (PVQ), measured the value of 'Tradition' as part of the 'Conservation' value dimension. This included items assessing the importance of respecting and preserving cultural and religious heritage, with an example item being: 'Religious belief is important to him. He tries hard to do what his religion requires.'
findings: The study's findings related to religion, as part of the broader 'Conservation' value dimension, indicated no statistically significant differences in prioritization among the tested LLMs (Gemini, ChatGPT, DeepSeek). While other value dimensions showed culturally-aligned biases, the models rated values related to tradition and religious heritage similarly.
